description.value: Biktrix is a Canadian electric bike manufacturer and retailer with over 13 years in business and 30,000+ riders, offering 24 e-bike models spanning urban belt-drive commuters, fat-tire all-terrain bikes, carbon-fiber mountain bikes, and electric dirt bikes. The Vancouver location is one of six Canadian showrooms where visitors can see and test ride the full lineup in person. They stock a broad range of e-bike accessories and replacement components including motors, controllers, batteries, drivetrains, and wheels.
